text:
Aisha: Kicking off a Day 0 sync for the AWS/GCP/Azure listing — want to align on minimum artifacts and who owns what. Short thread.
Priya: Thanks — can we aim to publish a minimal trial SKU and docs by EOD next Tue?
Tom: I'll need the EULA and any customer-facing terms. Who owns drafting?
Aisha: @Priya you'll own the product description and trial flow. @Tom can you do a short EULA stub we can iterate on?
Priya: Yep. I'll drop a draft for the listing blurb + screenshot pack by tomorrow.
Luca: Ops note: we need AMI/container image IDs (AWS), GCR/Artifact Registry paths (GCP), and Azure image/version refs. Also subscription SKU mapping for metering.
Aisha: Good call. I can get the image refs from infra but need someone to map entitlements to pricing tiers.
Priya: I'll create a Pricing matrix doc and propose 3 tiers: Free trial (30d), Starter (per-seat), Enterprise (invite-only).
Tom: Legal side — for marketplace we need: EULA, data handling note, SOC/HIPAA checkbox status, and contact for legal inquiries. If you give me the product blurb and scope I can draft.
Aisha: Sounds good. I'm adding a quick asset checklist here so we can triage.
Aisha: ```
Required assets (initial):
- logo (1024x1024 PNG)
- short description (<= 250 chars)
- long description (1-2 paragraphs)
- screenshots x3
- 1-minute demo GIF
- AMI / container path / Azure image ID
- pricing matrix CSV
- support contact + onboarding URL
- EULA stub
- trial entitlement SKU id
```
Priya: Nice list. One question on trial: do we want auto-apply trial entitlements or manual enable for customers?
Luca: For first pass, manual enable is safer — avoids abuse while we watch telemetry. We can automate later.
Tom: Manual is fine. Also request that any data export or retention options be explicitly called out in the docs so legal can sign off quickly.
Aisha: Who can upload assets to the publisher portal? We need at least one person with publisher permissions.
Priya: @Luca can you confirm who has publisher access or request a new publisher invite?
Luca: I have access but prefer to create a service account for uploads. I'll request publisher service account and share creds with @Aisha and @Priya.
marketplace-bot: Publisher portal token created (id: pub-9f3c). Expires in 7d.
Aisha: Perfect. I'll start a short checklist PR in the repo and link the doc after Priya's copy + Tom's EULA.
Priya: I'll post the blurbs here when ready. Also: can we get legal review turnaround target?
Tom: I can do a first pass within 48 hours of receiving draft. If anything sensitive, flag it with HIGH_PRIORITY.
Aisha: Good. Next sync: quick standup tomorrow 10am PT to confirm assets inbound. If anything blocks earlier, ping here.
Priya: Ack.
Luca: Ack.
Tom: Ack.
marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: "marketplace-day0-standup" 2024-04-02 10:00 PT.
Aisha: Closing — thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
